name: Jeff Martin
headline: Consultant, Developer and IT & Software Engineering Student
about:
If you take the time to read this bible of a summary, please know I am willing to develop my network even if I am not currently looking for any opportunity at the moment, being full time at CSSMB and planning while finishing my university degree. Below you will find a very old bio from 2020, please refer to my CV for my previous profesionnal experiences, those will be more professionnal than this. I wanna make sure my bio will be accurate and short, as I learned a ton of new cool stuffs in 3 years. It's in the making, too busy coding, having fun and sharing it with other people ;)
----
Last year, I took part in an internship as a consultant at Big Bang as part of my BAC in IT engineering. Thanks to this experience, I could consolidate my knowledge of business management obtained from Polyweb, a web agency I am the founder of, with my specialization in web and software development coming from my experience as a technician in multimedia integration. I am specialized in JavaScript and functional in Java. During this internship, in addition to analyzing the business processes of a company, I will have obtained two certifications from PSA Mavenlink, I will have been trained on Salesforce and I will have fully learned to use SuiteScript in order to customize NetSuite instances. I will have been able to adapt to unforeseen events and establish a sense of organization allowing me to face the inevitable obstacles of this profession, however technical or functional.

experiences.description:
Big Bang ERP is a boutique consulting firm that helps businesses optimize and streamline their operations with NetSuite ERP, Rootstock, Salesforce CRM, FinancialForce, Mavenlink and ServiceNow cloud systems as well as custom cloud-based software applications.

Our highly skilled team of experts works hand in hand with organizations to achieve exceptional business improvements by implementing, customizing and supporting the world's leading cloud-based business solutions.
Digital agency specialized in online training development and design (e-Learning).
